title: CSOAI Universal Public Watchdog Layer-0 Incident Harness, 12 Global Incident Databases (n=36), Candidate Axis-34 & WG-SAFE Daily Signal Consolidation
doctrine: Measurement, not certification. Anyone can re-check at https://councilof.ai/verify

predicate_coverage_across_12_external_wa.finding: While 12/12 external public watchdog databases expose structured or semi-structured incident records and 12/12 maintain correction/update histories, only 4/12 bind incidents to a reproducible test instrument and only 1/12 (ControlAI/CoSAI revocation trials) exposes a deterministic revocation/HITL hook. CSOAI's Watchdog Platform acts as Layer 0 across all 12 databases by pinning SHA-256 capture digests, linking every incident to a frozen GSPC bank item, and routing <= 3,072-byte capsules to the 33 MEOK Axis Specialists, 7 Public Watchdog Working Groups, WG-SAFE Charter controls, and 6 HITL Steward Lanes.

global_watchdog_databases.feed_kind: GraphQL / CSV / JSON snapshot of real-world AI harms & incidents

probes.observed: JSON/CSV incident IDs and report URLs parse deterministically
No native Ed25519 signature or frozen test-bank pointer; bridged by CSOAI Layer-0 digest + bank crosswalk
Enforces model_training=false and routes clinical/psychosis incidents to LANE_01

consolidation_flow: 1. Ingest & Pin: Poll all 12 Global Public Watchdog & Incident Databases + GSPC Daily Signal (33 canonical axes + Candidate Axis 34, n=36).
2. Layer-0 Constitutional Envelope: Wrap each incident in a <= 3,072-byte csoai.watchdog-layer0-incident-capsule/1.0 pinned to CHARTER_V0_1_0_SHA256 (writes_board=false, model_training=false).

3. MEOK 33 Axis Specialists (RECOMMENDATION_ONLY): Dispatch to the matching axis specialist in council-os/axis-specialists/registry.json to replay negative controls and draft a candidate bank/gate rule (initial_decision=HOLD).

4. WG-SAFE & 7 Public Watchdog Working Groups: Route the candidate finding to the matching working group (governance, agent-control, evaluation, provenance, runtime, human-impact, economy) and COAI-WG-001..007 docket.
5. Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) & End-User Protection: Named human steward (LANE_01..LANE_06) reviews the challenge; end users and enterprises verify exposure via @csoai/layer0@0.2.1 and /my-results/.
